collections.name: PUMPCREW
collections.description:
3,555 crew working a forecourt on Robinhood Chain.

Six pumps, one company each: NVDA, TSLA, HOOD, COIN, PLTR, AMD. Put a crew member on a pump and they work a shift. Every day the six are ranked by how their share price moved, and the prize pool pays out by rank.

Picking the winner is not the whole game. A pump's share is split between everyone standing there, so the crowded favourite can pay less per head than a quiet second place.

Half of every mint goes into the prize pool. The team cannot touch it: it pays out to crew, and nowhere else.

collections.name: FreqBit
collections.description:
FreqBit is an ongoing study on the visual geometry of sound, presenting a complete collection of 10,000 fully animated pixel matrix artifacts.

By capturing transient acoustic frequencies, harmonic resonance, ambient noise, and rhythmic pulses, FreqBit translates invisible soundwaves into structured, low-resolution animated GIF loops. Each piece exists as a living, breathing digital artifact where audio signal processing meets retro-futuristic pixel aesthetics.

Designed to be observed, collected, and appreciated for what it is: the raw, rhythmic pulse of sound and color encoded into seamless motion. 

Composition:
• 10,000 Unique Full-Animation GIF Artifacts
• Algorithmic audio spectrogram-to-matrix mapping
• Curated color palettes & crisp pixel grids
• Seamless looping motion driven by acoustic energy
